notes.title: ver1.09 released
notes.content:
[h1][b]fixed[/b][/h1]
　Fixed a crash problem when you try to counterattack in combat.
　Fixed an issue where the hit rate of the character "Beastman" was too low for attacks to hit.
　Fixed an issue where some characters are not translated when opening the treasure chest.
